nodes.name: actor.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the actor system for the Mozilla Remote Protocol (Chrome DevTools Protocol), including the ActorRegistry for managing registered actors, message routing between actors and client connections, and script/source actor lifecycle management.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses RwLock-based interior mutability pattern for thread-safe actor registry, with trait-based Actor abstraction for polymorphic message dispatch.

nodes.name: ActorError
nodes.summary: Enum representing error replies in the DevTools protocol, including missing parameters, bad parameter types, unrecognized packet types, and internal errors.

nodes.name: name
nodes.summary: Returns the human-readable name for an ActorError variant, matching Firefox DevTools error packet conventions.

nodes.name: base_name
nodes.summary: Extracts the simple type name from a fully-qualified Rust type path by splitting on '::' and taking the last segment.

nodes.name: new_actor_name
nodes.summary: Generates a unique actor name combining the base type name with an incrementing counter, ensuring uniqueness within the actor registry.

nodes.name: Actor
nodes.summary: Trait defining the core actor interface with methods for name, message handling, and cleanup, used by all DevTools protocol actors.

nodes.name: ActorAsAny
nodes.summary: Trait for downcasting Actor trait objects to Any, enabling type-safe downcasting of registered actors.

nodes.name: ActorEncode
nodes.summary: Trait for encoding actors to serializable values, used to send actor state through the DevTools protocol.

nodes.name: DowncastableActorArc
nodes.summary: Wrapper around Arc<dyn Actor> that provides downcasting support to access concrete actor types, using PhantomData for type safety.

nodes.name: deref
nodes.summary: Deref implementation for DowncastableActorArc that attempts to downcast the inner actor to the target type T.

nodes.name: RegisteredActor
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper around DowncastableActorArc providing Eq, Hash, Borrow, and MallocSizeOf implementations via delegation, used as keys in the actor registry's internal HashMap.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Acquires a write lock on the ActorRegistry, using a reentrancy guard to detect and prevent recursive write lock attempts.

nodes.name: ActorRegistry
nodes.summary: The central registry managing all DevTools actors, providing methods for registration, lookup, message forwarding, script/actor binding, and cleanup by stream.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers an actor in the registry by wrapping it in a RegisteredActor and inserting it into the actors map.

nodes.name: find
nodes.summary: Looks up a registered actor by name, downcasts it to the requested type T, and panics if not found or type mismatch.

nodes.name: encode
nodes.summary: Finds an actor by name and encodes it to a serializable JSON value for transmission over the DevTools protocol.

nodes.name: handle_message
nodes.summary: Routes incoming JSON messages to the appropriate actor, handling 'to' field resolution, type-based packet dispatch, and forwarding to ClientRequest for synchronous replies.

nodes.name: register_script_actor
nodes.summary: Binds a script ID to an actor name in both directions (script-to-actor and actor-to-script), enabling bidirectional lookup.

nodes.name: script_to_actor
nodes.summary: Resolves a script ID to its registered actor name, panicking with a descriptive error if no actor is found.

nodes.name: script_actor_registered
nodes.summary: Checks whether a script ID already has an actor registered, returning a boolean.

nodes.name: actor_to_script
nodes.summary: Resolves an actor name to its registered script ID, panicking with a descriptive error if no mapping exists.

nodes.name: register_source_actor
nodes.summary: Associates a source actor name with a pipeline ID for tracking source content by pipeline.

nodes.name: source_actor_names_for_pipeline
nodes.summary: Retrieves all source actor names registered for a given pipeline ID.

nodes.name: set_inline_source_content
nodes.summary: Stores inline source content for a pipeline ID, supporting conditional update only when new content is provided.

nodes.name: inline_source_content
nodes.summary: Retrieves previously stored inline source content for a given pipeline ID.

nodes.name: cleanup
nodes.summary: Removes all registered actors associated with a given stream ID, calling each actor's cleanup method before removal.

nodes.name: id.rs
nodes.summary: Provides ID mapping between Servo internal identifiers (WebView, BrowsingContext, Pipeline) and DevTools-specific numeric IDs for the remote debugging protocol.

nodes.name: IdMap
nodes.summary: Manages bidirectional mappings between Servo internal IDs and DevTools API IDs for browser instances, browsing contexts, and outer windows.

nodes.name: browser_id
nodes.summary: Maps a Servo WebView ID to a DevTools browser ID, creating a new sequential ID on first encounter.

nodes.name: browsing_context_id
nodes.summary: Maps a Servo BrowsingContext ID to a DevTools browsing context ID, creating a new sequential ID with overflow safety.

nodes.name: outer_window_id
nodes.summary: Maps a Servo Pipeline ID to a DevTools outer window ID, creating a new sequential ID with overflow checking.

nodes.name: DevtoolsBrowserId
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper around u32 representing a DevTools browser identifier.

nodes.name: DevtoolsBrowsingContextId
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper around u32 representing a DevTools browsing context identifier.

nodes.name: DevtoolsOuterWindowId
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper around u32 representing a DevTools outer window identifier.

nodes.name: value
nodes.summary: Returns the inner u32 value of DevtoolsBrowserId.

nodes.name: value
nodes.summary: Returns the inner u32 value of DevtoolsBrowsingContextId.

nodes.name: value
nodes.summary: Returns the inner u32 value of DevtoolsOuterWindowId.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the devtools library, implementing a remote DevTools protocol server that manages client connections, actor lifecycle, and event dispatch for navigation, console, DOM mutations, network, and debugger events.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a thread-based concurrency model with one thread for the listener acceptor and separate threads per client handler, communicating via crossbeam channels.

nodes.name: EmptyReplyMsg
nodes.summary: Minimal response message struct with only a 'from' field, used for replies that carry no additional data.

nodes.name: ActorMsg
nodes.summary: Enum wrapper for actor-related DevTools control messages, allowing generic message dispatch through the actor registry.

nodes.name: start_server
nodes.summary: Public entry point that spawns the DevTools server thread with memory profiling support, creating a DevtoolsInstance and running its event loop.

nodes.name: StreamId
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper around u32 providing unique identifiers for client streams, used to track connections during cleanup.

nodes.name: DevtoolsInstance
nodes.summary: Core state holder for the DevTools server, containing the actor registry, ID map, browsing context tracking, client connections, and message channel for receiving control messages from other components.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Constructs a DevtoolsInstance by binding a TCP listener, registering the RootActor, setting up ID mappings and connection tracking, and spawning the client acceptor thread.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Main event loop that processes incoming DevtoolsControlMsg variants, dispatching to the appropriate handler methods for navigation, console, DOM, network, debugger, and framerate events.

nodes.name: handle_navigate
nodes.summary: Handles page navigation events: updates browsing context actor pipeline info, emits will-navigate and target-available/destroyed notifications to watcher actors, and updates all open connections.

nodes.name: handle_new_global
nodes.summary: Handles creation of new global execution contexts (documents or workers): registers actors, maps IDs, creates browsing context actors, and manages worker thread tracking.

nodes.name: handle_title_changed
nodes.summary: Forwards page title change events to the associated browsing context actor for display in DevTools.

nodes.name: handle_console_resource
nodes.summary: Routes console resource messages (log entries, page errors) to the appropriate console actor and pushes them to all connected clients.

nodes.name: handle_dom_mutation
nodes.summary: Processes DOM mutation events by forwarding them through the browsing context, inspector, and walker actors to all connected clients.

nodes.name: handle_clear_console
nodes.summary: Sends a console clear message to the appropriate console actor, broadcasting to all open client connections.

nodes.name: find_console_actor
nodes.summary: Resolves the correct console actor name for a given pipeline and optional worker ID, searching worker actors or browsing contexts as appropriate.

nodes.name: handle_network_event
nodes.summary: Coordinates network event processing by looking up or creating network event actors and delegating detailed event handling to the network handler module.

nodes.name: create_network_event_actor
nodes.summary: Creates and registers a new NetworkEventActor, storing its name in the actor_requests map for later lookup.

nodes.name: handle_create_source_actor
nodes.summary: Creates and registers source actors for JavaScript source files, managing source content retrieval and attaching sources to thread or browsing context managers.

nodes.name: handle_update_source_content
nodes.summary: Updates the content of a source actor by name, falling back to inline source content storage when needed.

nodes.name: handle_debugger_pause
nodes.summary: Handles debugger pause events by creating a PauseActor, setting frame offsets, and sending paused notifications to the connected client.

nodes.name: handle_create_frame_actor
nodes.summary: Creates frame actors for stack frames during debugger pauses, looking up source actors and registering them in a thread-scoped manager.

nodes.name: handle_create_environment_actor
nodes.summary: Creates or updates environment actors for debugger scope representations, sending the actor name back to the caller via a result channel.

nodes.name: allow_devtools_client
nodes.summary: Verifies whether an incoming TCP connection should be accepted by peeking at the first bytes for authentication and requesting embedder approval via an allow/deny token exchange.

nodes.name: handle_client
nodes.summary: Handles an individual DevTools client connection: performs initial RootActor encoding handshake, then reads and dispatches JSON packets until connection closure or error.

nodes.name: debugger_value_to_json
nodes.summary: Converts DebuggerValue types to serde_json::Value representations, handling undefined, null, uninitialized, boolean, NaN, infinity, negative zero, numeric, string, and object values with preview support.
